records.authoredValue: Printing conflict: PHB p. 30 says monks attack as thieves; the DMG p. 74 cleric/druid matrix explicitly includes monks. Confirm which table the campaign uses.

records.assessment: PHB30 explicitly assigns the thief attack table; DMG74 cleric/druid/monk matrix explicitly includes monks. The authored note retains that conflict and requests a campaign choice; no numeric cells or ruling are newly approved.

records.authoredValue: UA p.23 explicitly freezes pick pockets, opening locks, and finding/removing traps at fifth-level ability, and reading magical writings is never gained. It says the acrobat retains move silently, hide in shadows, hear noise, and read languages acquired through fifth level, while climb walls increases with experience level. UA p.25 generally treats the acrobat as a thief except as indicated. These passages do not expressly give a new progression for the four retained abilities; no categorical freeze or automatic increases are supplied here.
records.method: Visually inspected actual private PDF page pixels at 108dpi, including applicable passages and table heading; compared authored note verbatim.
records.assessment: UA23 names ended fifth-level skills separately from retained abilities and explicitly increases climbing; UA25 says thief treatment except as indicated. The authored note preserves the distinction and does not invent an increase or categorical freeze for the retained abilities.
records.scope: Authored note meaning only. Does not approve new field-target highlighting, whole page/book completeness or numeric mechanics.
